meta.title: MixAI — TV, Music, Studio and Decks on every screen
meta.description: One self-hosted server, apps for every screen: watch on MixAI TV, listen on MixAI Music, organize in MixAI Studio, perform with MixAI Decks.

hero.title: Your media. Every screen. Your server.
hero.subtitle: MixAI Server keeps your movies, series, Live TV and music at home. The apps bring them to your TV, phone, computer and car — beautifully, and in sync.

tv.name: MixAI TV
tv.body: Movies, series, Live TV with catch-up and Watch Together. Cinematic on Android TV, Samsung, LG, Apple TV, Fire TV, phones and desktop.
tv.shotAlt: The MixAI TV home screen on a TV: the hero title, its artwork and a row of posters.

music.name: MixAI Music
music.body: Albums, artists, playlists, radio and synced lyrics. Offline downloads, beat-matched automix, CarPlay and Android Auto.

studio.name: MixAI Studio
studio.body: AI tagging, BPM and key analysis, smart playlists, downloads and server admin with a live dashboard.

dj.name: MixAI Decks
dj.body: Pro DJ software with a Rust audio engine, AI stems, beat sync and controller support.

server.name: MixAI Server
server.body: Self-hosted on Windows, macOS, Linux, Docker or a Raspberry Pi. Your library never leaves home.

sections.productsBody: Each app does one thing well. They share one sign-in, one server and one design.
sections.downloadBody: We highlighted the right download for this device.
sections.privacyBody: Your files stay on your server. Live TV plays your own sources or M3U lists — MixAI ships no channels.

launcher.subtitle: Pick up where you left off.
launcher.continueEmpty: Nothing in progress. Start something on MixAI TV.
launcher.continueError: Couldn't reach your server right now.
launcher.noServerBody: Install MixAI Server on a computer at home, then pair it to see your library everywhere.

dj.title: MixAI Decks
dj.subtitle: Pro DJ software with a Rust audio engine, AI stems and beat-matched automix. Free for Windows, macOS and Linux.
dj.shotAlt: The MixAI Decks screen: two tracks loaded, waveforms, mixer and library.

engine.title: Low-latency engine
engine.body: Native Rust audio with sub-10 ms latency, key lock and time-stretching.

stems.title: AI stems
stems.body: Split vocals, drums, bass and melody live, on your own machine.

library.title: Your MixAI library
library.body: Cues, tags and playlists from MixAI Studio, synced from your server.
